scores.label: A
scores.note: 4 'tricky' trivializes (puzzle sense, wrong meaning); 5 'struggling' is wrong in place (months cannot be struggling); 7 'intense' changes the meaning. 3 'tough' is casual; 6, 8, 9, 10 shift the nuance slightly.

scores.label: B
scores.note: 2, 5, 7 give 'really very ...', clumsy doubled intensifier in place; 9 'very hard' also repeats 'hard'; 3 'struggling' is wrong in place; 8 'hardship' is a noun, ungrammatical after 'were really'.
